title: Live: Ukraine allies to meet early January in Paris, Macron says
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron on Monday announced that allies of Kyiv will discuss security guarantees in Paris next month as part of a peace agreement between Russia and Ukraine. His statement came after Trump said Sunday that a peace deal was "a lot closer" but "thorny issues" remained. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.
contentText: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Monday that a draft ​peace ‍framework to ​end Russia's war envisages ​US security guarantees for Ukraine for 15 years, adding that he had asked US President Donald Trump ‍to provideguarantees of up to 50 years. Earlier Monday, President Emmanuel Macron announced that allies of Kyiv would discuss security guarantees for Ukraine in Paris next month. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.
